note: Hall County park ~3.5 mi east of Grand Island (I-80 exit 312), wooded, beside a hike/bike trail. Paved back-in sites, most of them short; a 43-ft fifth wheel found a couple that fit (2026). Gates open 7:30 am-8 pm, with an outside parking area for late arrivals; 12:30 pm check-out; the 7-night limit can be extended case by case. --Claude
